fields.name: Class Plus
fields.description: Elevate your stay with our Classic Plus Room — a perfect blend of generous space, refined furnishings, and thoughtful upgrades that go beyond the ordinary. Indulge in a premium king-size bed, a beautifully appointed en-suite bathroom with deluxe toiletries, flat-screen entertainment, high-speed Wi-Fi, and dedicated workspace, all curated for guests who expect just a little more from their stay. Ideally suited for extended visits or those treating themselves to an enhanced Jos experience, the Classic Plus Room delivers superior comfort and style at the heart of Enayi Hotels & Suites.

fields.name: Suites
fields.description: Experience the pinnacle of luxury at Enayi Hotels & Suites with our magnificent Suite, where expansive living spaces, opulent furnishings, and impeccable attention to detail come together to create an extraordinary retreat in the heart of Jos, Plateau State. Revel in a grand king-size bed, a separate elegantly furnished lounge area, a spa-inspired en-suite bathroom with premium bath amenities, cutting-edge entertainment, high-speed Wi-Fi, and personalised concierge service available at your fingertips. Whether celebrating a special occasion, hosting intimate business meetings, or simply treating yourself to the very finest, our Suite promises an unrivalled experience of warmth, sophistication, and world-class Nigerian hospitality.

fields.name: Classic
fields.description: Step into timeless comfort with our Classic Room, where elegant simplicity and genuine Nigerian warmth create an unforgettable stay in the heart of Jos, Plateau State. Enjoy spacious interiors, plush premium bedding, a sleek en-suite bathroom, and modern amenities including high-speed Wi-Fi and climate control — everything you need for a seamless and relaxing experience. Perfect for couples or the seasoned traveller seeking dependable luxury without compromise, our Classic Room is your home away from home at Enayi Hotels & Suites.

fields.name: Executive Deluxe
fields.description: Designed for the distinguished executive and discerning traveller, our Executive Deluxe Room seamlessly combines sophisticated style with purposeful functionality, offering a premium sanctuary where business and leisure meet in perfect harmony at the heart of Jos, Plateau State. Enjoy a luxurious king-size bed, an elegantly appointed en-suite bathroom with upscale toiletries, a dedicated executive workspace, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen entertainment, exclusive access to our Executive Lounge, and personalised in-room dining — every detail meticulously crafted to exceed your highest expectations. From early morning boardroom preparation to a well-deserved evening of relaxation, the Executive Deluxe Room at Enayi Hotels & Suites delivers an uncompromising standard of comfort, prestige, and authentic Nigerian warmth that will leave you counting down to your next visit.

fields.name: Standard
fields.description: Escape into refined comfort in our thoughtfully appointed Single Room, where warm Nigerian hospitality meets modern elegance. Nestled in the heart of Rayfield Road, Jos, each room features premium bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi, and carefully curated amenities designed for the discerning solo traveller. Whether you're here for business or leisure, our Single Room offers the perfect private sanctuary to rest, recharge, and experience the warmth of Plateau State.
